name: Godou Kaiten
source: Father of Godou Daisuke and Fujieda Mio, and leader of the Yakuza. To protect Mio from being used as a bargaining chip during underworld transactions, he separated from his wife while Mio was still an infant and had her take his wife's maiden name.  He bears a strong hatred for anyone who would use his family to manipulate him.
